data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Arlenus, meaning ‘eagle dweller’ or ‘arisen in the mountain meadow’. The name Arlenis carries the meaning “Mountain meadow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Arlenis usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
